works.body:
件名:3面図依頼
本文:醤油です。
うちの子の白夜ちゃんの形態の一つ
【死神式刈取特化形態Λ】（端的にいうとゴスロリ）の三面依頼です。
送付した先の資料の中のタブの一つにΛ のことも書かれていて
ベース設定と基本形態αを見た後の方がわかりやすいかもです。

記載されてないこと以外は好きに趣味全力全開で大丈夫です。

よろしくお願いしまふ

https://x.com/hakuyakemomm_21/status/1956437935433331168?s=46&t=ubAzs2LnbXGhsmBbOPS7Rw

お疲れ様です！
久しぶりにリクエストお願いしたいな…と思い投げさせていただきます✨

ツイートを見てたら“栞葉るり”さんというのを見たので、今回はるりさんをお願いしたいと思います！
無茶振りを承知で…。まだ出てないのですが、paryuuが似合うと思う私服でお花見をしてるイラストが欲しいです…。
検討をお願いします！！

Hello X, I've seen your wonderful illustrations!
Individual buituber Nazu Yumehana @Nazunazu_Hakase
I would like to ask for a fan art of @Nazunazu_Hakase
As for the expression and pose
（I'd like to see her expression and pose.
I may use it as a thumbnail or for a good morning video, but I'd appreciate it if you could do it for me.

I'm Ken and I'm always happy to help you.
I love all of PaRyuu's illustrations because they are all so cute. ❤️
I would like to make a request for you to draw Polka Omaru.

I would like to draw a scene in which she is dressed in her casual clothes and is going for a photo shoot in the autumn leaves.
If it's too difficult, I'm fine with what PaRyuu thinks of as an autumn foliage date, so thank you in advance!

Hello.
I saw your illustration on Twitter.
It was very attractive and I would like to make a request.

I would like to request the singer "Haru" who is my favorite singer.
I would like to request "Haru", a singer who is one of my favorites.
Reference: https://x.com/haru_8_20/status/1700435304002498975?s=46&t=9YRN4la4ifwyZ9zvgn_1bw

I would like to use it as fan art.
FA picture tag #Haru color palette
I would like to post it on YouTube, Twitter, TikTok, etc.
Posting on YouTube, Twitter, TikTok, and other SNS
We would like to ask for your permission to use the image as an icon, thumbnail, video, or in a video distribution.
It would be greatly appreciated if you could deliver separate data of people without backgrounds.

We would like to have a fragile atmosphere of a person waiting for someone on a winter night with a little snow on his head and shoulders while checking the time on his watch.

He should be dressed in dark blue with a long pea coat and a light blue scarf covering his mouth.

Other poses and compositions are up to you.

Thank you in advance for your consideration.

https://x.com/haru_8_20/status/1693911427525095778?s=46&t=9YRN4la4ifwyZ9zvgn_1bw

初めまして個人でVTuberをさせて頂いている富貴桜華と申します。

知人のVTuberの方がPaRyuu_様の企画のイラストをあげており
その絵柄に惹かれまして依頼させて頂きました。

色々とイラストを拝見させて頂いて特に沙花叉さんの水着イラストがとても可愛く、素敵でしたので
是非私の水着姿のイラストを描いて頂けないでしょうか。

私の立ち絵は以下になります。
